request: AI Core distinguish model startup delay from OOM and inspect Docker health

bounded_host_request.command: for c in ai-coder ai-qwen3; do echo MODEL=$c; docker inspect "$c" --format 'running={{.State.Running}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} finished={{.State.FinishedAt}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}'; docker logs --since 8m "$c" 2>&1 | grep -E 'model loaded|listening on|load_model:|error|failed|OOM|operator\(\)' | tail -8; done; echo PARENT_EVENTS; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/ai.slice/ai-core.slice/memory.events 2>/dev/null || true
